sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Minigolf' is a game about precision and accuracy. Players take turns rolling a ball through a series of obstacles and challenges, with the goal of completing each level in the fewest number of shots possible. The game is divided into 19 levels, each with its own unique theme and challenges. From straightforward holes to more complex obstacles, each level presents a new set of challenges for players to overcome.

One of the key mechanics of 'Minigolf' is the use of power and spin. By carefully aiming and adjusting the power and spin of your shot, you can control the ball's trajectory and increase your chances of success. This adds a whole new level of depth and strategy to the game, as players must carefully consider their shot and plan their approach carefully.

Another key mechanic of 'Minigolf' is the use of obstacles. From windmills to tunnels, each level features a variety of obstacles that players must navigate in order to complete the level. These obstacles add a fun and challenging element to the game, as players must carefully plan their shot and adjust for the obstacles in their way.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of 'Minigolf' are simple yet addictive. With each level presenting a new set of challenges, players will be hooked from the very first shot.
